summary: The EXP-0032 source calibrated tail 52 at 9/15 completions (60.0%). Three independent 92,160-transition PPO trials then cleared tail 52 in 27/27 frozen episodes, while every retained tail 32, 36, 40, 44, and 48 also cleared 27/27. All three trials retained every boundary, all three qualified game seeds completed, losses were finite, and training plus evaluation had zero controller restarts. Select seed-102001. This accepts assisted reverse-curriculum expansion only and authorizes another retained-window experiment; it is not normal-start Zone 2 evidence.
